title: FurtherAI Named to Harmonic's Hot 25 Startups List
summary: FurtherAI was named to Harmonic's Hot 25, a ranking built from the aggregated interest of thousands of VCs. What that signals for commercial insurance AI.
body_markdown:
FurtherAI has been named to[Harmonic's Hot 25 Startups list](https://harmonic.ai/hot-25-startups/q3-2025) , a ranking of early-stage companies built from the aggregated interest of the thousands of venture capital (VC) firms that use Harmonic to find their next investments.


There's no application and no judging panel. Harmonic reads investor activity across its platform and reports which early-stage companies the market is watching. For a company selling into commercial insurance, that's a useful signal.


## **How the Harmonic Hot 25 is built**


Harmonic is a startup data platform that VC firms use to source and track early-stage companies. The Hot 25 "ranks the top early-stage companies based on aggregated investor interest from the thousands of VCs using Harmonic to find their next investments."


An editorial list reflects the judgment of whoever assembles it. A ranking built from aggregated platform behavior reflects what a large population of investors did with their time, which is harder to lobby and more useful as a read on where the market is looking.


## **What we're building at FurtherAI**


FurtherAI builds agentic AI for commercial insurance workflows, including submission intake, policy check and compare, statement of values (SOV) intake, underwriting audit, and claims processing, for[carriers](https://www.furtherai.com/segment/carriers) ,[managing general agents (MGAs)](https://www.furtherai.com/segment/mgas) ,[brokers](https://www.furtherai.com/segment/brokers) , and[reinsurers](https://www.furtherai.com/segment/reinsurers) . Source citation and human review are designed in rather than bolted on.


There's a proof point we'd put ahead of any ranking: we're live at five of the top 10 carriers and work with five of the top 15 brokers and wholesalers. In October 2025 we[raised a $25M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz](https://www.furtherai.com/blog/%20furtherai-announces-25m-series-a-from-andreessen-horowitz-to-transform-insurance-workflows-with-ai-automating-busywork) to accelerate that work. In 2026 we[entered the London market with a dedicated UK and EU team](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260518611218/en/FurtherAI-Appoints-Tom-Bradley-to-Lead-UK-and-EU-Expansion) and are expanding across Europe, backed by a[fully EU-hosted instance](https://www.furtherai.com/blog/furtherai-launches-eu-hosted-instance) that keeps every workflow inside European borders.


Thank you to Harmonic for the recognition, and to the customers, investors, and team who make this kind of momentum possible. If you want to see whether the platform holds up on your own documents, that's the conversation we'd rather have.
